Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I have a small deck and this grill fits it perfectly.  So far it has lit every time, heats up quickly and evenly.  From April to October we cook practically every dinner and many lunches outside.  The reviews we had read earlier said it was difficult to assemble, but we found it went together logically and easily.  My one down on this grill is it is difficult to move.  Because of our small deck the "drop leaf" side is down and there is no place to grab on to so we can roll it around.  I made the mistake of trying to pick it up be the front piece just under the igniter button and broke that piece.
Results.Title: Great for a small deck.

Results.ReviewText:
The grill itself seems great so far.  I hope it is built for the long run. What I found most unfortunate was that after getting halfway through the long process of self-assembly, a pack of hardware was missing. This eventually turned into a 2 hour ordeal at Home Depot to get a replacement pack. I spent another 20-30 minutes trying to get Weber to communicate with me (they were totally non-responsive through the Covid19 pandemic). 

Home Depot ended up taking the hardware from another grill at the store, and sending the other grill BACK to Weber. Talk about a waste of time and resources, nevermind my personal frustrations. 

All told, I think I spent 6.5 hours before I had my first burger on this grill. My time is worth more than that.
Results.Title: Grill Itself Seems Good But Self Assembly . . .

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
